mapper.sql: select C.id, C.name, C.season, C.created_at createdAt from golf_contests C

select P.id pickId, P.contest_id pickContestId, P.created_at pickCreatedAt, T.id tournamentId, T.name tournamentName, T.starts_at tournamentStartsAt, T.ends_at tournamentEndsAt, exists(select 1 from golf_tournament_results TR where TR.tournament_id = T.id) hasResults, G.id golferId, G.name golferName, G.country golferCountry, R.finish_position finishPosition, R.prize_money prizeMoney from golf_picks P join golf_tournaments T on T.id = P.tournament_id join golf_golfers G on G.id = P.golfer_id left join golf_tournament_results R on R.tournament_id = P.tournament_id and R.golfer_id = P.golfer_id
mapper.select: select T.id, T.contest_id contestId, T.name, T.course, T.starts_at startsAt, T.ends_at endsAt, exists(select 1 from golf_tournament_results TR where TR.tournament_id = T.id) hasResults from golf_tournaments T where T.contest_id = #{contestId} order by T.starts_at, T.id
select id, name, country from golf_golfers order by name
select count(1) > 0 from golf_contest_entries where contest_id = #{contestId} and user_id = #{userId}
where P.contest_id = #{contestId} and P.user_id = #{userId} order by T.starts_at, T.id
